basics.name: L. Jonathan Haas
basics.label: Director, Web Development, University Communications
basics.summary: Web development leader with 25 years in software, including 13 at the University of Pennsylvania, rising from senior developer to director in University Communications. Manage the communications side of Penn's websites, including the sites under the President's Center, and own the strategy, infrastructure and day-to-day health of Penn's most visible web properties, bridging editorial, leadership and engineering while staying hands-on with the technology.

work.name: University of Pennsylvania
highlights: Manage the communications side of Penn's websites, including the sites that fall under the President's Center.
Lead the web platform behind Penn Today, the university flagship site and a portfolio of school and executive-office sites.
Set technical direction across hosting, deployment and development standards, including the move to modern Drupal on managed cloud hosting.
Built and grew the team's practices for accessibility, documentation and project delivery.
Serve as the university's lead on hosting-vendor partnerships and on web governance with communications leadership.

skills.name: AI
keywords: AI-assisted development with human code review

projects.name: Self-hosted homelab and personal web builds
projects.description: Self-hosted homelab (Docker, Cloudflare Zero Trust, Tailscale, Linux) and personal web builds in Node.js and on Cloudflare infrastructure.
